description: She wears an opaque muted burgundy floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and full skirt. Narrow tan-gold geometric woven borders frame the neckline, shoulder bands, cuffs, vertical front and hem. A cream underdress shows through a modest below-knee walking opening. A golden-brown wool wrap with burgundy patterned edging rests across her forearms and hangs down both sides. A narrow patterned belt closes at a round metal clasp. Brown leather shoe toes show beneath the hem. No headgear or weapon is visible.
